# InsightOps

InsightOps is an AI-powered multi-tenant operations dashboard covering inventory, scheduling, expenses, and analytics.

- [Inventory Ledger](https://insightops-saas.vercel.app/inventory)

- [Expense Tracking](https://insightops-saas.vercel.app/expenses)
- [Smart Search Assistant](https://insightops-saas.vercel.app/ai-assistant)
- [Operations Reports](https://insightops-saas.vercel.app/reports)
- [Subscription Billing](https://insightops-saas.vercel.app/billing)
